entries.def:
ἀσμένως 
adv. (ἥδομαι, to be glad), [in LXX: 2Ma.4.12 2Mac.10.33, 3Ma.3.15 3Mac.5.21 * ;] 
gladly: Act.21.17.†
(AS)

ἄ-σοθος, -ον 
[in LXX: Pro.9.8 א2 Α * ;] 
unwise, foolish: Eph.5.15.†
(AS)

ἀσπάζομαι depon., 
[in LXX: Ezk.18.7, Jdg.18.15 (שָׁלוֹם שָׁאַל), Est.5.2, 1Ma.7.29, al. ;] 
to welcome, greet, salute: with accusative of person(s), Mat.5.47, Mrk.9.15, Act.21.7, al.; id. before ἐν φιλήματι, Rom.16.16, 1Co.16.20, 2Co.13.12, 1Th.5.26, 1Pe.5.14; τ. ἐκκλησίαν (Deiss., BS, 257), Act.18.22 as term. tech. for conveying greetings at the end of a letter (MM, see word), used by an amanuensis (Milligan, NTD,…

ἀσπασμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀσπάζομαι), 
a salutation (so always in RV), greeting: oral, Mat.23.7, Mrk.12.38, Luk.1.29, 41; 1.44; 11.43; 20.46; written, 1Co.16.21, Col.4.18, 2Th.3.17.†
(AS)

ἄ-σπιλος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., σπῖλος) [in Sm.: Job.15.15 (LXX, καθαρός)* ;] 
spotless, unstained: 1Pe.1.19 metaphorically, 1Ti.6.14, Jas.1.27, 2Pe.3.14 (for exx., see MM, see word).†
SYN.: ἀμίαντος, ἄμωμος (AS)

ἀσπίς, -ίδος, ἡ 
[in LXX for פֶּתֶן, etc. ;] 
an asp: Rom.3.13.†
(AS)

ἄσπονδος, -ον
(σπονδή, a libation); 
__1. without truce (Thuc.). 
__2. admitting of no truce, implacable (Dem., al.): 2Ti.3.3.†
(AS)

ἀσσάριον, -ον, τό
(diminutive of Lat. as), 
an assarion, a farthing, one-tenth of a drachma: Mat.10.29, Luk.12.6 (MM, see word; DB, iii, 428; DCG, ii, 200).†
(AS)

ἆσσον (Rec., after Vg., Ἄσσον), 
adv. (compar. of ἄγχι, near), 
nearer: Act.27.13 (RV, close in shore; see B1., § 11, 3; 44, 3; poets, Ion, and late prose).†
(AS)

Ἄσσος, -ου
(also Ἀσσός, -οῦ), ή 
Assos, a city on the E. coast of Asia Minor: Act.20.13-14 (see: ἆσσον).†
(AS)
